discussion_comments.comment_body: `shutdownSession` and `releaseSessionRuntime` both start with `beginTeardown`, `session.pluginCommandsClosing = true` and `emitTaskCompletedOnTeardown`, and both then abort an active turn, wait for `pluginCommandTail`, and shut down the agent, the runtime and the plugin sandbox, with near-identical comments explaining why. Please move the first three lines into `beginTeardown` and put the shutdown steps in one method both functions call. What is left in each function will then be the real difference: the status and end event `shutdownSession` writes, and the runtime release `releaseSessionRuntime` performs.

Done. `beginTeardown` now also sets `pluginCommandsClosing`, emits the `task.completed` fallback and aborts the active turn (it runs before teardown's first await, which is where the abort has to be), and `shutDownSessionRuntime` holds the plugin-tail wait and the agent/runtime/sandbox shutdown. `shutdownSession` is left with the persist wait, the status write and the `ended` event; `releaseSessionRuntime` with the release. Net −22 lines.

We have a number of config.outputMode === "json" type branches here already. Could we look at making a role interface and, at the start, new up a "Json outputter" or a "console outputter" or whatever we have so we don't have to keep threading these conditionals through the code?

Already this if-else shows some things don't make sense... like "verbose json" output doesn't print model provider info. IF those are orthogonal, the code should reflect that and have the verbosity flow to all outputters.

It is OK if some outputters ignore calls they don't care about, but it will help clarify what the purpose of these events are, like "this is the start of a session run", etc. by choosing good method names.

Thanks — I refactored the run path around a `RunOutputter` role (`JsonRunOutputter` / `ConsoleRunOutputter`) created once at the start of `runAgent`. The `outputMode` branch is now isolated to the factory; lifecycle output uses straight-line calls (`runStarted`, `runResult`, `runAborted`, etc.), and `verbose` is passed into both outputters. Verified `bun -F @cline/cli typecheck`, Biome on the changed files, and `run-agent.test.ts` (22 passed). Pushed in `f8405b5`.

Fixed in ab093fb5e. All 13 flat constants are exported again from `@cline/ui/components/mermaid-diagram` as aliases of the current grouped config values (`DIAGRAM_NAMING`, `DIAGRAM_ZOOM`, `MERMAID_FONT`, `PNG_EXPORT`), so the groups stay the single source of truth and the flat names can't drift. A new façade test (tests/diagrams/mermaid/exports.test.ts) imports all 13 names from the entry point and asserts they equal the grouped values; suite is 343/343 green and typecheck passes.
This adds a lot of code that's command-tool specific. I think it'd be better if we split it into a separate tool-level module,

follow up: suggest moving resolveSessionListTitle into @cline/core/src/services/session-data/ or similar, then:

- Replace SDK's inferTitleFromMessages() calls with it
- Update desktop-app to import from SDK instead of local session-data/common

That keeps the logic centralized while respecting the dependency graph (apps can depend on @cline/core, but not vice versa).
